subject: 243 Mystic Avenue Life Science Lab Rezoning
overview: The Council approved a zoning map amendment to create a Planned Development District at 243 Mystic Avenue for an eight-story life science facility. The body also discussed expanding tree maintenance to private ways and strengthening enforcement of short-term rental and commercial parking regulations.

items.title: Routine resolutions and condolences
items.summary: Approved routine resolutions honoring Italian American Heritage Month, the Medford road race, and the lives of George Cataldo and Judith Collusion.

items.title: Common Victualler license approvals
items.summary: Approved license applications for Bocelli’s Restaurant and Lucy’s Craft Deli and Rotisserie.

items.title: Executive session regarding litigation
items.summary: Entered executive session to discuss strategy for a pending Department of Industrial Accidents case involving the City of Medford.

items.title: Public hearing on 243 Mystic Avenue PDD
items.summary: Approved a zoning change to establish a Planned Development District for an eight-story life science and laboratory building.

items.title: Short-term rental reporting requirements
items.summary: Referred a request to the Zoning Planning and Development Subcommittee to require monthly reports from rental platforms to improve ordinance enforcement.

items.title: Commercial and overnight parking restrictions
items.summary: Referred petitions to the Traffic Commission to prohibit overnight parking on Commercial Street, Mystic Avenue, and Ring Road to mitigate tractor-trailer and commercial vehicle storage.

items.title: Board of Health and Traffic Commission regulations
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that all Board of Health and Traffic Commission regulations be hosted on the city's MuniCode website.

items.title: Tree maintenance on private ways
items.summary: Referred a proposed ordinance amendment to the Committee of the Whole to provide city tree-trimming services to residents living on private ways.

items.title: Brooks PTO food truck permit
items.summary: Approved a food truck permit for a school event.
